description: Insights M2: migrate all nine trending charts + EpicProgressList off the Dashboard Productivity zone onto /insights below the Signal Summary, regrouped under four question-led dimension groups (产出/交付效率/质量/投入), each chart annotated with its current data time window. Pure frontend relocation + regrouping; no backend/API/schema change.

tasks.title: Migrate chart components off the Dashboard into the insights page tree and remove the Productivity zone
tasks.spec: specs/dashboard-shell/spec.md#The Dashboard is an attention/pulse surface and SHALL NOT render a Productivity or charts zone
tasks.description: Physically relocate the generic chart primitives (pages/dashboard/charts/ → pages/insights/charts/) and the 10 composed components + model/ (pages/dashboard/productivity/ → pages/insights/panels/), keeping them as siblings so every ../charts import keeps resolving byte-for-byte. Because moving the components strands ProductivityZone.tsx (its imports point at the now-moved files), this task also deletes ProductivityZone.tsx + .test.tsx and narrows the Dashboard: drop the 'productivity' slot from DASHBOARD_ZONES and the ProductivityZone import/branch in DashboardPage.tsx, and remove 'productivity' from DashboardZoneId in DashboardZone.tsx. Move each component's colocated test with it. Update DashboardPage.test.tsx so the slot-identity test asserts the productivity zone is absent and drop the migrated-chart content assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: pages/insights/charts/ and pages/insights/panels/ (with model/) exist; pages/dashboard/charts/ and pages/dashboard/productivity/ are gone; the 10 colocated *.test.tsx files moved with their components

DashboardPage renders no zone with the productivity identity and mounts none of the migrated trend charts (ThroughputChart, CompletionTrend, CumulativeFlowChart, CycleTimeChart, StageDurationChart, QualityPanel, FtrTrendChart, InvestmentPanel, CostTrendChart, EpicProgressList)
Dashboard factory-status headline, full-width AttentionHero, Pulse zone, and Digest zone still render in their existing positions and content (unchanged)
DashboardPage.test.tsx asserts the productivity zone is absent and no longer asserts migrated-chart content; relocated component tests pass under their new paths
npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: Relocated charts/ and panels/ trees under pages/insights/, deleted ProductivityZone.{tsx,test.tsx}, narrowed DashboardPage.tsx + DashboardZone.tsx, updated DashboardPage.test.tsx
tasks.notes: Bundles D1 (relocate) with D5 (dashboard narrowing) because the import graph couples them: the move strands ProductivityZone, whose deletion requires unmounting it from DashboardPage. Relocated-but-unmounted components stay compiling; InsightsPage still renders the M1 placeholder until T-003 — an accepted intermediate state.

tasks.title: Annotate each migrated chart with its current data time window
tasks.spec: specs/insights-charts/spec.md#Each migrated chart annotates the data time window its existing endpoint already yields
tasks.description: Add a purely-presentational time-window badge to the header chrome (alongside the existing <h3>, tagged data-testid="<chart>-window") of the six charts that do not already show their window: ThroughputChart (30d, fixed), CycleTimeChart (30d, fixed), CumulativeFlowChart (derived from data.rangeFrom/rangeTo), StageDurationChart (derived from data.window.from/to), FtrTrendChart (derived from trend.from/to), and CostTrendChart (derived from data.rangeFrom/rangeTo). Source each label from the hook data the component already consumes — no wrapper-level or duplicate hook calls. Hide the badge when a server-range chart has no range (empty state). Do NOT touch chart-body rendering, data-fetch, lens toggles, overlays, empty states, or ChartAccessibility summaries, and do not add a range selector. Leave CompletionTrend/QualityPanel/InvestmentPanel (already display their window) and EpicProgressList (live snapshot, exempt) untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: ThroughputChart and CycleTimeChart show a 30d window badge
CumulativeFlowChart, StageDurationChart, FtrTrendChart, and CostTrendChart show a badge derived strictly from the range their endpoint already returns (no invented window)
Server-range badges are hidden when the range is null (empty state), matching the chart's own empty handling
No chart exposes a time-range selector control and no chart's underlying window is changed
No migrated chart's internal rendering, data-fetch, interaction, empty-state, or accessibility behavior is altered by the badge addition
Each of the six components' colocated test asserts its new <chart>-window testid; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: Window badges in the six relocated chart components (pages/insights/panels/) + updated colocated tests
tasks.notes: Implements D4. CompletionTrend ('{n} weeks' meta), QualityPanel ('Last 7/30 days'), and InvestmentPanel ('cumulative across project history') already annotate their window and need no badge; EpicProgressList reads a live snapshot with no endpoint window and is exempt (asserted in T-003).

tasks.title: Render the migrated charts on /insights in four fixed dimension groups and remove the M1 placeholder
tasks.spec: specs/insights-charts/spec.md#The Insights page renders the migrated trend charts in exactly four fixed dimension groups below the Signal Summary
tasks.description: Add two components under pages/insights/ui/: ChartGroup (props {id,title,question,children}; renders <section data-testid="insights-chart-group" data-dimension="<id>"> with a question-led heading) and InsightsCharts (renders exactly four ChartGroups in fixed order from one declarative array). Group spec: 产出 (output) = EpicProgressList, ThroughputChart, CompletionTrend, CumulativeFlowChart; 交付效率 (delivery) = CycleTimeChart, StageDurationChart; 质量 (quality) = QualityPanel, FtrTrendChart; 投入 (investment) = InvestmentPanel, CostTrendChart. In InsightsPage.tsx replace <ChartPlaceholder /> with <InsightsCharts /> and delete ChartPlaceholder.tsx + its index export. Add InsightsCharts.test.tsx (spec) and update InsightsPage.test.tsx to flip the placeholder assertion to the four chart groups; leave Signal Summary structure/empty/populated/graceful-degradation tests unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly four dimension groups render below the Signal Summary in the fixed order 产出, 交付效率, 质量, 投入 — no fifth group, none omitted

Each group heading carries its question-led title and each group contains exactly its assigned chart testids (产出: EpicProgressList + ThroughputChart + CompletionTrend + CumulativeFlowChart; 交付效率: CycleTimeChart + StageDurationChart; 质量: QualityPanel + FtrTrendChart; 投入: InvestmentPanel + CostTrendChart)
EpicProgressList renders first in the 产出 group; its placement does not add, remove, or reorder the four groups' membership
The M1 chart-placeholder zone (data-future="charts-m2") no longer renders; the Signal Summary remains the conclusions-first first screen with its verdict content/derivation unchanged
InsightsCharts.test.tsx asserts the six D4 window badges are present (and the existing-label charts carry their window copy) and that no time-range selector is rendered anywhere
InsightsPage.test.tsx asserts the four chart groups render instead of the placeholder; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: ChartGroup + InsightsCharts components, InsightsPage.tsx wiring, deleted ChartPlaceholder.tsx + export, InsightsCharts.test.tsx (spec) + updated InsightsPage.test.tsx
tasks.notes: Implements D2 + D3 and the insights-signal-summary placeholder-removal requirement. The composition's spec test asserts window badges, so it depends on T-002. Completes the insights-charts 'reachable exclusively on /insights' requirement together with T-001's Dashboard removal.
